sentences.en: The company went after its no. 1 customer complaint: power outages.
sentences.zh: 公司针对最大的客户抱怨：停电问题。

sentences.en: I've had it. All I've done today is handle complaints.
sentences.zh: 我受够了。今天我只处理了一些投诉。

sentences.en: There have been a lot of complaints about your behavior.
sentences.zh: 对你的行为有很多抱怨。
